verdict.rationale: Slack documents a first-party workspace data export and an import/export tools guide, so a native export path exists. Community evidence reports that exporting DMs and private channels (Corporate Export) requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval, which limits the "all of my data" part of the story. The cited docs are only article titles, so neither the export format nor its openness is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented open export format details, self-serve export of DMs and private channels without vendor approval, evidence of complete coverage (files, canvases, lists), and hands-on corroboration of a successful migration out.
